author: blekek.k
title: Looking for illustrators for trading card project
content: Hi warga threads! We're looking for illustrators for our little trading card project. Whether you draw professionally, as a hobby, are still a student, or already work full-time, feel free to reach out. We're looking for artists that draws - Anime / manga style illustrations - Cartoon / semi-cartoon illustration - Pokemon / One Piece / MTG TCG artwork - Semi-realistic illustrations - and any other art styles. Comment if you're interested or DM me directly! Author follow-up: Thanks you guys for reaching out. I'll be checking your portfolio. For the ones who haven't sent in their portfolio, you can provide a link where I can see your previous works.

author: Kat
title: Paid B&W illustrations for short story series
content: Looking for a human artist for some small, paid illustration work. NO AI ART. No AI tools. I want to pay an actual artist for actual art. I'm writing a series of short stories, and as I finish each one, I'm planning to release them digitally for free. Eventually, they'll all be compiled into a physical book, so I don't need full cover designs for every individual story. What I am looking for is a small black-and-white illustration for each story that gives Scary Stories to Tell in the Dark. Ideally an artist who can gently teach me how much they should be paid for each illustration. I have most of one short done now, have 12 total planned. Artist would get credit as the artist/illustrator. Contact: DM on Threads (also mentioned Instagram).
